Text: Finally, we have Tamer men and women here!
I want to have a strong Tamer! This feels great!
Dats must be frantically looking for me, I guess?
Haha! I want to find a strong Tamer! Come and get me, if you think you can! Ha ha ha!!
Was that you guys who were following me? What a shame… just for Digimon...
Hopefully the Dark Tower that I have made suits your taste?
I'm just here just to say hello, so reviews and comments can wait~ ha ha ha!
Are there any Glacier Army around?
Yoohoo~ I'm free~~~
Stop right there, people from the Real World!
I'm Gallantmon of the Royal Knights, who guard the Digital World…
You humans must be behind the series of events as they unfold from now on.
…but all your decisions and actions should be for the sake of the Digital World.
From now on, I'll be watching you. So be careful with every step and action.
Hmm… this tower must not be in use any more…
What took you so long, Dr. Akihiro Kurata? Don't you already know what I'm about to tell you?
Ha ha ha… so you're the Digimon Kaiser… terms are accepted at least, but…
I need the power from your Dark Tower…
Hmph, ridiculous~ how can a mere human control its power?
Hey Kaiser, with our combined power, we can make the plan work sooner than expected…
Even sooner… so what do you say? Will you join me?
Hahaha… but will it be real? Well, ok… you can use the Dark Tower's power.
Of course… hehehehe.
Fools… you have done exactly what you were meant to do.
Hissing… whirring…
Humans, prove how sincere you are…
Shall I test my Gizumon now?
…hehehehe…
Only that kind of sincerity will open the door to the path that can correct this world.
You must be aware that I need something in return.
But most importantly… don't forget that this world belongs to me.
(The player travels from the Dark Tower Wasteland to the Digimon Maze Entrance with Starmon.)
We're here.  This is the Digimon Maze Entrance I mentioned earlier.
It's your first time here.  You will probably lose your way easily.
There are fearsome digimons here and there in this place.
You are too weak to enter the Entrance safely.
I'm rather busy right now, so I won't be able to go right to the Entrance,
but I will at least accompany you near the Entrance, so relax.
I'll go slow.  Stay close.  (*runs off*)
(Shows up flying)  Ta-da!  Hahaha!
I am SuperStarmon, the immortal master investigator with style and the looks!!  Hahaha!
Now, why would you be loitering about here?
This place is far too dangerous for rookies like yourselves.
How did you end up so weak?  Had some traumatic experiences in your youth or something?  Ha!
You should just gain more experience in the area.
Anyway, I am desperately needed elsewhere.  Ciao!  Hehehe! (Creepy laughter)
Teehee...  How long will you stay alive here, I wonder?  *chuckles*
(Huffing and puffing)  We have finally made it to the 2nd floor of the Digimon Maze...
This place is much quieter than I had expected.  Almost too quiet...
Let's be careful and move on one step at a time.
Anyway, if you want to exit the Maze, just tell me anytime.
(Slowly coming to) Have you broken the seal that has bound me for so long?
Bang Bang! I am the justice spirit, Deputymon.
Welcome to Digimon Farm. Very hot weather is an attraction of this area. HaHaHa.
If you want to know something, ask me.
Of course~ Only "woman" can ask me!
Anyway, why don't you have a cool~ Welcome Milk with me when you are convenient!
Hello. I am Hawkmon. Nice to meet you.
I am the descendant of special tribe that was abundant in ancient period. I can't tell you detail now.
All people that have met me have said that I am polite and courtesy person.
I also think that I am cool and calm person.
How do you think about my hair decoration? I received it from Garudamon, who I respect very much. It is very precious to me.
When I come back alone from the travel with my partner, Inoue Papa,
All Digimons in the area were in rampage condition.
When I looked around, I could find several humans in the area.
I will research the accident that occurred in the area step by step from now.
Tamer! Please help my research.
I am Devimon, the most powerful and the most evil digimon.  I trust that you have heard of my renown at least once?
You have made it to D-Terminal 2F.  You are stronger than I could have known.
But, you will have spent much of your energy getting here.  This gives me the upper hand!
Mwahahaha!  Did you think you could defeat me with that pathetic power of yours?
If we cross paths again, you will receive the devil's baptism with Death Claw.  I will make your tomb where you stand!
How dare you challenge me and my plan to take over this world with the Black Cogwheel!
Very well!  If you will survive so tenaciously, I will eliminate your kind one by one.  Mwahahaha!
I am Pajiramon.  You have come seeking me, tamer?
You do understand that I am one of the Great Twelve, do you not?  Hahaha!
The Great Twelve refer to the twelve beasts, that is, the twelve zodiac digimons.
Hmm?  Do I know who Devimon is?  I have never seen such a digimon in this area...  (I could see that Pajiramon was a little shaken up by the question.)
(Pajiramon quickly changes the subject at the mention of Devimon.)  I have a favor to ask of you.  It should not be that difficult for you.
Fine, fine.  Just... do me this favor, would you?  This is urgent.  (Again, I felt that Pajiramon's smile was rather sinister.)
Ugh…  We've finally made it to the first floor of the Maze.
It is still… heart-wrenching to think about them…  Pray that they will find a place of comfort in their death.
Anyway, we should begin our search in this area.
As you know, the structure of this Maze is quite complex.
If you are not careful, you will easily be lost.
Now, then, let's start by searching the first floor of the Digimon Maze thoroughly.
Ta-da!  Enter the genius once again!
Hahaha!  You don't need to be so surprised.  I am always one step ahead of you all.
Eh?  What am I doing here, you ask?  Well… it's… err… none of your business!  (He doesn't seem to know why he's here, either, really).
Anyway, it looks like I, the brilliant Master Investigator, must come to the rescue yet again.
Someone is likely conspiring not to allow anyone to the upper floors.
Now, assist me and search the surrounding areas.
We will certainly find the culprit behind this!
In the first place, the Maze was mine to protect.  My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place.
However, Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away.  Since then, the safety of this place has been compromised.
Digimon Kaiser is conducting some kind of an ongoing experiment.
Not a day goes by without the screams of digimons in the upper floors.
I am certain that he is up to no good.  Please, stop Digimon Kaiser and recover my body.
I will let you through to the upper floor.  Please, come and find me.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
At last, we are on the second floor.
A new place calls for a new attitude.
Let's start our search again.  It's a brand new day!
The second floor of the Maze seems even more complex than that of the first floor.
If you are not careful, you will easily be lost.
Now!  Let's leave no stone unturned on this second floor of the Digimon Maze.
Yeah, baby!  Woo hoo!  I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
What?  Why am I in a place like this, you ask?  Curious, are you?
Shut yer cakehole!  It ain't none of your business.
I like to be noticed by others anytime, anywhere.
And I'm violent to boot.  Mwahahahaha!
No matter.  I have my reasons for being here, so don't go on prying.
Ta-da!  Enter the ingenious Master Investigator once again!
Oh?  Aren't you the ones that I ran into on the first floor?
We run into each other on the first floor by chance, and then we do the same on the second floor…  Chance?
Perhaps… you are stalking me?  Or, perhaps, this is a sign of incredible respect for me?
Anyway, this Maze is complex.  This has to be someone's conspiracy.  A trick to keep this Master Investigator trapped in this place.
Now, assist me and search the surrounding areas.
Once again we will certainly find the culprit behind this!
In the first place, the Maze was mine to protect.  My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place.
However, Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away.  Since then, the safety of this place has been compromised.
Digimon Kaiser is conducting some kind of an ongoing experiment.
Not a day goes by without the screams of digimons in the upper floors.
I am certain that he is up to no good.  Please, stop Digimon Kaiser and recover my body.
I will let you through to the upper floor.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
At last, we are on the third floor.
We will need to calmly look around in this area.
Let's not give up but keep pushing ourselves.
This third floor of the Digimon Maze seems have a symmetrical, mirror-image structure.
Again, if you are not careful, you will easily be lost.
Now!  Let's leave no stone unturned on this third floor of the Digimon Maze.
Yeah, baby!  Woo hoo!  I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
We meet again!
Shut yer cakehole!  It ain't none of your business.  How many times do I have to tell you?
I am the best of the best!
Hahaha!  I am Etemon, the most handsome and powerful digimon!
You just put your faith in me, Etemon, the most powerful king of digimons.
Ta-da!  Enter the ingenious Master Investigator once again!
What was that frown that crossed your face?
I see.  The quick frown totally gives you away.
You are… full of respect for moi!  Hahaha!
I don't blame you…  Anyway, I want to exit this complex Maze.
Now, you will assist me - the one you oh-so-respect - and search this area step-by-step!
We will certainly find the culprit who is in hiding somewhere!
* grinds and sputters *
In the first place, the Maze was mine to protect.  My responsibility was to protect the ancient artifacts and treasures in this place.
However, Digimon Kaiser seized this place and sealed my body away.  Since then, the safety of this place has been compromised.
Digimon Kaiser is conducting some kind of an ongoing experiment.
Not a day goes by without the screams of digimons in the upper floors.
I am certain that he is up to no good.  Please, stop Digimon Kaiser and recover my body.
I will let you through to the upper floor.
If we restore the Maze to the way it used to be, I should be able to find my body as well.
Please remember that the only way to stop him is for me to find my body.
*snickers* At last, you are here.  Welcome.  Shall we begin this party? *snickers*
Finally, after all that trouble, you've made it to the fourth and the final floor, tamer!
I can't believe it was Digimon Kaiser that we've been chasing after all this time…
I will show him no mercy!
To think of all those who were sacrificed because of him... Grrrr!
Tamer, I'm counting on you.
I know you can do it.
Yeah, baby!  Woo hoo!  I am Etemon, the most powerful digimon in existence!
What?  That's Digimon Kaiser?  And you've been chasing after him all along?
Well…  It really has nothing to do with me, but…
You work for me, Etemon the Great, "the Most Powerful Digimon in Existence" and the "King of Digimons".
Go and get Kaiser.  Make a bun out of him.

You just need to follow after me!  But once we are there, you're pretty much
on your own.  Hahaha!
See?  I knew it!  I just knew it!
Digimon Kaiser was the culprit!
My deduction was 100% right!
Not a word of a lie - it was so accurate that it gives me the chill!
Now that I have successfully found out the culprits with my fantastically brilliant brain,
I will give you the honor of wrapping this up.
Not only am I the most brilliant Master Investigator, I am also VERY generous!
Hmm…  We have finally come to the end of the Digimon maze…  You must be exhausted.
We have solved many challenging puzzles, and finally came to where we are today.  A lot has happened since we first began.
It seems that my role here is done.
The rest is up to you.
Seeing your progress so far, I'm sure you will do just fine.
Chief Leomon was looking for you, so go and see him.
How can this be?!  Everything was perfect!
This… this is a nightmare!  What a terrible ending…
Now that it has come to this…, I will start everything all over again!  Everything!!
I will reset the Digital World.
I will…  I will return home first, and wipe all data from the computer…
And… and… I will start right from the beginning again!!!
Don't think this is over!  (He disappears into the distance.)
Digimons and humans should never have met in the first place.
But, I changed my mind after witnessing the love between that human from before and a digimon.
(He seems to be talking about Keenan Krier and Frigimon.)
Right now, he doesn't understand
what it is that he should truly hate…
SaberLeomon!  Unless you change your mind,
the world of digimons will have no future!
What do you know, human?  How dare you speak to me!
I never speak with humans.
Every terrible thing that is happening in the Digital World
is because of you humans.
You claim to protect the Digital World…  Hrmph!  What a joke!
Take this message to Mercurymon, too,
that I will never ever listen to him!
Ah…  It is you…
I was worried that Digimon Kaiser, the source of evil,
seized the Maze and sealed my body, compromising the safety of this place…
Yet, you have defeated him and helped me recover my body.  Words cannot describe my gratitude to you.
Now, as the guardian of this Maze, I will continue to protect ancient artifacts and treasures.
Let me tell you a story…
Once upon a time, the Primeval Digital Era comes to an end,
and the Ancient Digital Era began.
Yet, peace never came.
Humanoid digimons and beast digimons began their fight.
The cause of this fight traces back to the Three Great Angels.
Seraphimon and Ophanimon loved humanoid digimons.
However, Cherubimon, an angel digimon in the form of a beast, loved beast digimons.
The will of the Three Great Angels was divided, and Cherubimon declared war on humanoid digimons.
The war raged on.
Then, a digimon by the name of Lucemon suddenly appeared.  He stopped the war and restored peace.
But, before long, Lucemon became corrupt.  He went into the Fallen Mode and began to threaten the entire Digital World,
until the Ten Warriors appeared, sealed Lucemon, and disappeared leaving their spirits behind.
However, this was all in the past.
Still, Mercurymon and SaberLeomon open a new chapter,
and a new story is about to begin.
A new story of war between humanoid digimons and beast digimons.
Did you think this was over?  The story has not yet come to an end…  It never will…
